name: Java
short_description: Platform-independent OOP, JVM architecture, garbage collection, and collections.
description: Enterprise-grade Java programming covering JVM bytecode, OOP principles, interfaces, exception handling, collections framework, generics, and concurrent multithreading.

courses.title: Java Programming
courses.description: Enterprise object-oriented Java covering JVM internals, collections, and concurrency.

modules.title: Java Fundamentals
modules.description: JVM, JRE, JDK, bytecode compilation, primitives, and string pool.

topics.title: JVM Architecture & Bytecode
topics.summary: Class loaders, execution engine, heap/stack areas, and JIT compiler.

topics.title: Syntax, Types & Control Flow
topics.summary: Primitive and reference types, operators, conditionals, loops, and methods.

topics.title: Strings, Arrays & Wrapper Classes
topics.summary: Immutable strings, StringBuilder, arrays, autoboxing, and equality pitfalls.

modules.title: Classes & Objects
modules.description: Class members, constructors, static keyword, and garbage collection.

topics.title: Class Definitions & Memory Allocation
topics.summary: Reference types, garbage collection roots, and method overloading.

modules.title: Inheritance
modules.description: Single inheritance, super keyword, and method overriding (@Override).

topics.title: Extending Classes & Super Keyword
topics.summary: Subclassing, superclass constructor invocation, and final classes.

modules.title: Polymorphism
modules.description: Compile-time vs runtime polymorphism, dynamic method dispatch.

topics.title: Runtime Polymorphism & Dynamic Binding
topics.summary: Upcasting, downcasting, and instanceof type checking.

modules.title: Abstraction
modules.description: Abstract classes, partial implementation, and design guidelines.

topics.title: Abstract Classes & Method Contracts
topics.summary: Declaring abstract methods and enforcing derived contracts.

modules.title: Interfaces
modules.description: Interface contracts, multiple implementation, default/static methods.

topics.title: Interface Contracts & Default Methods
topics.summary: Multiple inheritance of type and functional interfaces.

modules.title: Exception Handling
modules.description: Checked vs unchecked exceptions, try-catch-finally, and try-with-resources.

topics.title: Checked vs Runtime Exceptions
topics.summary: Throwable hierarchy, AutoCloseable, and custom exceptions.

modules.title: Collections
modules.description: List, Set, Map interfaces, ArrayList, HashSet, HashMap, and iterators.

topics.title: Java Collections Framework Core
topics.summary: HashMap bucketing, equals/hashCode contracts, and List implementations.

topics.title: Lambdas & the Streams API
topics.summary: Functional interfaces, method references, and stream pipelines.

modules.title: Generics
modules.description: Type parameters, bounded type parameters, and wildcard expressions (? extends T).

topics.title: Generic Types & Wildcard Bounds
topics.summary: Type erasure, PECS rule (Producer Extends, Consumer Super).

modules.title: File I/O
modules.description: Reading and writing files safely with the modern API.

topics.title: File I/O with java.nio
topics.summary: Paths, Files, buffered readers and writers, and try-with-resources.

modules.title: Multithreading
modules.description: Thread class, Runnable interface, synchronized keyword, and Executors.

topics.title: Thread Synchronization & Concurrency
topics.summary: Intrinsic locks, volatile keyword, and java.util.concurrent thread pools.
